## Skills {.unnumbered .unlisted}

::: pm-skills
Epidemiology and data analysis
: R, statistical analysis, data management and visualisation

GIS and spatial epidemiology
: QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, SaTScan, Google Earth Engine, risk mapping

Surveillance and public health
: Disease and community-based surveillance, risk assessment, monitoring and evaluation, mixed methods

Field and qualitative research
: ODK, KoboToolbox, NVivo, key informant interviews, thematic analysis

Laboratory and molecular methods
: PCR, Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing

Languages
: Chichewa (native), English (professional)

Registration
: Malawi Board of Veterinary Surgeons
:::
